$ labctl scenario info drill
Name:        drill
Display:     Drill
Category:    reliability
Description: Practise on demo-app
Status:      inactive

Prerequisites (apps):
  - demo-app

Parameters (override with --set Name=value):
  Level                  Difficulty (default: 1)
                           How hard the drill is

Objectives:
  - Bring demo-app back

Components (1):
  - setup [script]

Checks (1) - run 'labctl scenario verify drill':
  - fixed [script]

$ labctl scenario verify drill

Error: 1 of 1 checks failed
[exit 1]

$ labctl scenario verify drill

All 1 checks passed.
